records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Freight revenues increased 14% during the second quarter of 2022 compared to 2021, resulting from higher fuel surcharges, core pricing gains, and positive mix of traffic, partially offset by a 1% volume decline.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Freight revenues increased 14% in the quarter compared to the same period in 2021 driven by a 16% increase in average revenue per car (ARC), partially offset by a 1% decline in volume.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The Company reported earnings of $2.93 per diluted share on net income of $1.8 billion and an operating ratio of 60.2% in the second quarter of 2022 compared to earnings of $2.72 per diluted share on net income of $1.8 billion and an operating ratio of 55.1% for the second quarter of 2021.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The ARC increase was due to higher fuel surcharge revenues, core pricing gains, and positive mix of traffic (for example, a relative decrease in intermodal shipments, which have a lower ARC).

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: These increased costs mostly offset the higher revenues as operating income increased 1% in the second quarter compared to the same period in 2021.
